title: RNA-seq of P. brasilianum SFC20200506-M13 co-cultured with Bacillus subtilis DK1042 wild type, replicate 1
design_description: Total RNA from a Penicillium brasilianum SFC20200506-M13 / Bacillus subtilis co-culture. RNA was treated with the RNase-Free DNase I Set (Qiagen) and purified with the RNA Clean & Concentrator-25 kit (Zymo Research); integrity was checked on an Agilent 2100 Bioanalyzer (RIN 9.1-10.0 across all samples). Poly(A)-selected, strand-specific library prepared with the Illumina TruSeq Stranded mRNA Library Prep Kit following TruSeq Stranded mRNA Reference Guide #1000000040498 v00 (dUTP protocol, read 2 corresponds to the sense strand). Paired-end 101 bp sequencing on an Illumina NovaSeq X at Macrogen Inc., Seoul, Republic of Korea (order HN00283426).
